info.title: lip Daemon JSON-RPC API
info.description: API for interacting with the lip package installer daemon.

methods.name: CacheClean
methods.description: Deletes all data lip has cached, as lip cache clean. Installed packages, the lock and the configuration are not affected.

methods.name: ConfigDelete
methods.description: Resets a configuration key to its default value, as lip config delete. Fails when the key is not a configuration key.

params.name: key
params.description: The configuration key to reset.

methods.name: ConfigGet
methods.description: Gets the value of a configuration key, as lip config get. Fails when the key is not a configuration key.

params.name: key
params.description: The configuration key to get.

methods.name: ConfigList
methods.description: Lists every configuration key with its value as a string, as lip config list.

methods.name: ConfigSet
methods.description: Sets a configuration key to a value, as lip config set. Fails when the key is not a configuration key.

params.name: key
params.description: The configuration key.

params.name: value
params.description: The configuration value.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Writes a format 4 concrete manifest.json in the daemon working directory, as lip init: named after the directory, entry "<name>.dll", type "native", version "0.1.0", no dependencies. Fails, leaving the file unchanged, when manifest.json exists.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs the requested packages and their dependencies, as lip install; the requested packages become explicitly installed. Fails when a requested package is already explicitly installed or two arguments request the same identity. Each element of packages is a package argument (CLI section 2): an https:// URL [#variant] of a ZIP archive; a local ZIP file [#variant], absolute or relative to the daemon working directory; or a package path [#variant] optionally followed by @<version>, @branch:<name>, @tag:<name> or @rev:<40-digit commit id>. A local directory is rejected.

params.name: packages
params.description: The package arguments to install.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: As --dry-run: reports the changes the operation would make without changing the workspace or the lock, and runs no command.

params.name: ignoreScripts
params.description: As --ignore-scripts: package commands (scripts) are not run.

params.name: noDependencies
params.description: As --no-dependencies: installs exactly the first candidate of each request as explicitly installed, following no install edges and installing or uninstalling no other package; the workspace may be left broken.

params.name: rid
params.description: The .NET runtime identifier (e.g. "win-x64"), as --rid. null, an empty string or an omitted rid means the option is not given: the rid then comes from the lock, otherwise from the runtime lip runs on.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists the packages of the workspace lock in installation order, as lip list. Changes nothing.

result.name: packages
result.description: Two arrays: the explicitly installed packages, then the dependencies, each entry as "<identity>@<version>".

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Converts the package repository in the daemon working directory from tooth.json (format 1, 2 or 3) to a format 4 manifest.json, as lip migrate: the converted keys an existing manifest.json lacks are added to it without changing the keys it has, then tooth.json is deleted. What cannot be converted, and each existing key whose value differs from the converted value, is reported through PrintWarning. Fails, changing nothing, when tooth.json is missing or tooth.json or an existing manifest.json cannot be read.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls packages, as lip uninstall. Each element of packages names installed packages by identity (ignoring ASCII case), or else by the first ref of the resolution chain they were installed from (a ref without a variant matches every variant, a ref without a git ref every git ref; a local file path is resolved as in Install). Fails when an element names no installed package. Without noDependencies, the named packages must be explicitly installed; they stop being explicitly installed, packages no remaining explicitly installed package needs are uninstalled, and a named package other packages still need is kept as a dependency.

params.name: packages
params.description: The installed packages to uninstall.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: As --dry-run: reports the changes the operation would make without changing the workspace or the lock, and runs no command.

params.name: ignoreScripts
params.description: As --ignore-scripts: package commands (scripts) are not run.

params.name: noDependencies
params.description: As --no-dependencies: uninstalls exactly the named packages, dependencies included, and no other package; the workspace may be left broken.

params.name: rid
params.description: The .NET runtime identifier (e.g. "win-x64"), as --rid. null, an empty string or an omitted rid means the option is not given: the rid then comes from the lock, otherwise from the runtime lip runs on.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates packages, as lip update. Each element of packages is a package argument as in Install and is requested again: without @, its newest version; with @<version>, that version; with a git ref, the commit it names now. Every requested package must already be installed. An empty packages list is lip update without arguments: every explicitly installed package is requested again by the first ref of its resolution chain (an unpinned spec ref takes its newest version, a branch its current head, a tag the commit it points to now, a rev the same commit; a URL is requested again and may be served from the download cache; a local file is read again, and when it no longer exists the package is kept and a warning is sent). A package is replaced only when the result differs in identity, version, archive key or archive identifier.

params.name: packages
params.description: The package arguments to update; empty to update every explicitly installed package.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: As --dry-run: reports the changes the operation would make without changing the workspace or the lock, and runs no command.

params.name: ignoreScripts
params.description: As --ignore-scripts: package commands (scripts) are not run.

params.name: rid
params.description: The .NET runtime identifier (e.g. "win-x64"), as --rid. null, an empty string or an omitted rid means the option is not given: the rid then comes from the lock, otherwise from the runtime lip runs on.

methods.name: Versions
methods.description: Lists the versions of a package path (its v<SemVer 2.0.0> tags), without the leading "v", in ascending SemVer precedence, as lip versions.

params.name: package
params.description: A package path, path[#variant], without @. The variant does not affect the result.

methods.name: View
methods.description: Returns the root document of the archive a package argument points to, as lip view: tooth.json when the archive has one, otherwise manifest.json. For a package path the archive is that of its newest version, of the given version, or of the commit the git ref names. A routing document is returned as it is and not followed. Changes nothing.

params.name: package
params.description: The package to view: a package argument (CLI section 2): an https:// URL [#variant] of a ZIP archive; a local ZIP file [#variant], absolute or relative to the daemon working directory; or a package path [#variant] optionally followed by @<version>, @branch:<name>, @tag:<name> or @rev:<40-digit commit id>. A local directory is rejected.

methods.name: PrintInfo
methods.description: Request sent by lipd to the client: an informational message. The client must answer with the result null; lipd does not proceed with the method that sent it until the answer arrives.

params.name: message
params.description: The message to display.

methods.name: PrintSuccess
methods.description: Request sent by lipd to the client: a success message. The client must answer with the result null; lipd does not proceed with the method that sent it until the answer arrives.

params.name: message
params.description: The message to display.

methods.name: PrintWarning
methods.description: Request sent by lipd to the client: a warning. The client must answer with the result null; lipd does not proceed with the method that sent it until the answer arrives.

params.name: message
params.description: The message to display.

methods.name: PrintError
methods.description: Request sent by lipd to the client: an error message. The client must answer with the result null; lipd does not proceed with the method that sent it until the answer arrives.

params.name: message
params.description: The message to display.

methods.name: ReportProgress
methods.description: Request sent by lipd to the client: progress of a running task. The client must answer with the result null; lipd does not wait for the answer.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifies the task; all reports of one task carry the same id.

params.name: message
params.description: A human-readable description of the task; the same in all reports of one task.

params.name: percentage
params.description: The progress reached so far.
